title: Requirement
description: A single mandatory policy requirement extracted from a USDA directive. Extracted by keyword-anchored sentence boundary detection on SHALL / MUST / IS REQUIRED TO / ARE REQUIRED TO / WILL BE REQUIRED TO / ARE PROHIBITED FROM / ARE PROHIBITED. Each element is one item in the `requirements` array of a Rego module.

id.description: Unique requirement identifier. Format: {pkg_name}-req-{NNN}. pkg_name is the Rego package suffix (e.g. dr0100_001). NNN is zero-padded sequence within the directive. Part files continue numbering (e.g. -req-076 in _part2).

section.description: Section number key matching the `sections` object key where this requirement was found.

section_title.description: Human-readable section or appendix heading corresponding to the `section` key.

text.description: Full sentence (or near-sentence fragment) containing the mandatory keyword, as extracted from the directive source text. Whitespace-normalized.

keyword.description: Normalized trigger keyword class. 'shall' captures 'shall'; 'must' captures 'must'; 'required' captures 'is required to', 'are required to', 'will be required to'; 'prohibited' captures 'are prohibited from', 'are prohibited'.

mandatory.description: Always true. All extracted requirements are mandatory. Non-mandatory guidance is not captured in the requirements array.

examples.text: All Departmental directives must be submitted electronically using the Directives Management System.
